seo.title: Google Sheets AI chatbot and order sync | Steps AI
seo.description: Use a Google Sheet as a source for your AI agent and sync orders from a sheet into Steps AI. No store platform needed.

hero.title: Run your agent from a Google Sheet.
hero.body: Many businesses keep prices, stock or orders in a spreadsheet. Connect the sheet and your agent can answer from it, and your orders can be synced into Steps AI without a store platform.
hero.reassurance: Pick a sheet in a few clicks. Clear sync results. No store platform required.

lines.text: What is the price of the 5 kg rice bag?
The 5 kg bag is 620. It is available for delivery this week.

useCases.title: What you can do with Google Sheets connected.
useCases.intro: Useful when your business runs on spreadsheets instead of a store platform.

items.title: Use a sheet as a skill source
items.body: Choose a sheet with the Google picker and your agent can use it to answer, for example price lists, stock lists or timetables.

items.title: Sync orders from a sheet
items.body: Keep orders in a Google Sheet and sync them into Steps AI, so the agent can answer order questions.

items.title: See what changed on each sync
items.body: Every sync shows how many rows were added, updated and skipped, with a clear message if something in the sheet needs fixing.

items.title: Update the sheet, not the agent
items.body: Your team edits the spreadsheet as usual, and the agent works from the latest version after the next sync.

walkthrough.title: From a spreadsheet to answers in the chat.
walkthrough.intro: How a business without an online store uses Google Sheets.

steps.label: Pick the sheet
steps.agent: Yes, we deliver to Kondapur on Tuesdays and Fridays.
steps.note: Delivery areas come from a sheet chosen with the Google picker.

steps.label: Answer a price question
steps.customer: How much is the 5 kg rice bag?
steps.note: Prices are read from your price list sheet.

steps.label: Answer about an order
steps.note: Orders synced from the sheet are available to the agent.

setup.title: Connect Google Sheets in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Google Sheets
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Google Sheets. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Google Sheets to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Choose the sheet and what it is for
items.body: Use the Google picker to select the sheet, then use it as a skill source, an order sync, or both.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Keep column names consistent. If the sheet layout changes, the sync shows which rows were skipped and why.
Order answers reflect the last sync, so sync again after large changes.

faq.title: Questions about the Google Sheets integration.

items.q: Do I need Shopify or WooCommerce?
items.a: No. Google Sheets works on its own, which suits businesses that keep orders and prices in a spreadsheet.

items.q: What happens if a row is wrong?
items.a: The sync skips it and tells you, with counts of added, updated and skipped rows.

items.q: Can the agent edit my sheet?
items.a: The agent reads from the sheet to answer. Your team keeps editing it as usual.
